name: 256 px layer tiles

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## 256 px layer tiles

Mechanism: halve the layer tile side (512 to 256 device pixels) so the visible tile set wastes less at its edges and the tile textures take less GPU memory. Allowed: the two TILE_SIZE constants. Forbidden: budget, overscan.
measurementPlanMarkdown: bm.sh e06 over the four scroll scenarios against the E5 results, 3 reps. Pass: footprint down at least 5% on scroll-div-cards and scroll-data-table with CPU not worse.
reportMarkdown:
## 256 px layer tiles Finished

Passed: false. The footprint did not fall (div-cards +4%, data-table +1%): the tile textures are not the edge waste the hypothesis assumed, so smaller tiles only add draws. Reverted.

Attempt Count: 1. Out-of-scope changes: none.
